Columns of a DE table used by the DE table helpers

Source: R/process_rnaseq.R
de_helper_columns.Rd

Finds the log2 fold change and adjusted p-value columns of a DE table for rank_de_genes(), generate_de_rank_file() and filter_de_genes(), from the same presets as standardize_de: columns given explicitly win; otherwise they come from `method`, detected from the column names when "auto".

Usage

de_helper_columns(data, method, logfc.col, padj.col)

Arguments

data

A DE table

method

"auto", "edgeR", "DESeq2", "limma" or "seurat" (case is ignored, as the old `de_method` argument did)

logfc.col, padj.col

Columns given by the user, or NULL

Value

A named character vector with `logfc` and `padj`
